description: Shelfy web (shelfy-api on refs.niccolofanton.dev): HTTP, jobs, storage, containers, backups, archive and ingest (plan §3.6). Source: the Shelfy repo, deploy/osn/shelfy/grafana/03-shelfy.json.
title: 03 - Shelfy

panels.title: shelfy-api
panels.description: Blackbox probe of http://shelfy-api:8080/health on the internal network (probe_success).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Version of the running shelfy-server (shelfy_build_info).

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All HTTP requests per second, 5 min rate.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status over 5 min.

panels.title: SSE connections
panels.description: Open /api/v1/events streams (shelfy_sse_connections).

panels.title: Open user DBs
panels.description: Libraries open in the handle cache (shelfy_open_user_dbs; cap 64, plan §2.3).

panels.title: Requests/s per route group
panels.description: Route groups from the route template: api (/api/*), sse (/api/v1/events), media (/media/*), health, web (the web app and unmatched paths).

panels.title: Latency per route group (p50, p95, p99)
panels.description: Time to the response headers (shelfy_http_request_duration_seconds). §6.2 budgets: list p95 40 ms, search p95 60 ms, detail p95 15 ms, media p95 5 ms.

panels.title: Responses per status class
panels.description: Responses per second by status class (2xx to 5xx).

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95, last hour)
panels.description: The ten route templates with the highest p95 over the last hour.

panels.title: Jobs per kind and state
panels.description: Jobs the scheduler holds (shelfy_jobs): ready (due, waiting for a slot), delayed (waiting for their run time, such as a retry backoff) and running.

panels.title: Oldest queued job per kind
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued job (shelfy_job_oldest_queued_seconds); the queue-stuck alert fires above 30 min (capture.site 2 h).

panels.title: Job attempts per hour by outcome
panels.description: Ended attempts in the last hour, by kind and outcome (shelfy_job_duration_seconds): succeeded and failed end a job; retried, requeued, interrupted and lease_expired run again; cancelled is the user's.

panels.title: Job duration p95 per kind
panels.description: p95 of the attempt run time over 30 min (shelfy_job_duration_seconds), all outcomes.

panels.title: Libraries vs budget
panels.description: shelfy_disk_bytes{area="users"} against the 30 GB media budget (SHELFY_MEDIA_BUDGET_GB); new archives stop at 100 %.

panels.title: Root disk used
panels.description: Used share of / on the host (node-exporter); alerts at 85 % (warning) and 90 % (critical).

panels.title: Disk by area
panels.description: shelfy_disk_bytes by area. Budgets (plan §3.1): libraries 30 GB, video cache 5 GB; work, uploads, exports and backup staging 3 GB together.

panels.title: SQLite busy
panels.description: SQLITE_BUSY results per second (shelfy_sqlite_busy_total).

panels.title: Open user databases
panels.description: Libraries open in the handle cache (cap 64, 10 min idle).

panels.title: g480 rendition size
panels.description: p50 and p95 of the g480 grid renditions written in the selected range (shelfy_rendition_bytes); budget p50 35 KB, p95 60 KB.

panels.title: CPU per container
panels.description: CPU cores used by the Shelfy containers and Hermes, side by side (limits: shelfy-api 1.5, Hermes 2).

panels.title: Memory per container (% of limit)
panels.description: Working set over the memory limit; the Shelfy memory alert fires above 90 %.

panels.title: Host memory available
panels.description: MemAvailable on the host; the host-contention alert fires below 800 MB.

panels.title: Host load (5 min)
panels.description: 5-minute load average on the 4 vCPUs; the host-contention alert fires above 6.

panels.title: Database backup age
panels.description: Time since the last successful run; red after 3 h, like its stale-backup alert. No data while backups are off.

panels.title: Media backup age
panels.description: Time since the last successful run; red after 36 h, like its stale-backup alert. No data while backups are off.

panels.title: Restic maintenance age
panels.description: Time since the last successful run; red after 8 days, like its stale-backup alert. No data while backups are off.

panels.title: Restore drill age
panels.description: Time since the last successful run; red after 35 days, like its stale-backup alert. No data while backups are off.

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: Result of the last run of each backup job (1 = success, 0 = failure).

panels.title: CDN fetches by outcome
panels.description: Archive fetches per second by CDN host group and outcome (shelfy_media_fetch_total): stored, expired (no request; the extension refreshes), gone, blocked (counts toward the breaker), transient, rejected, breaker_open (nothing sent).

panels.title: Breakers
panels.description: 1 while a host group's breaker is open or half-open (shelfy_breaker_open): the archive hands that platform to the extension until a probe passes. The breaker alert reads the same series.

panels.title: Archive backlog
panels.description: Items left to the server's archive per platform (shelfy_archive_backlog), as the drains last counted them: due or backed off, failed ones excluded.

panels.title: Covers archived within 15 min
panels.description: Share of the covers stored within 900 s of their post's insert in the selected range, and the p95 (shelfy_archive_cover_latency_seconds; posts inserted in the last 7 days only). P2 exit: at least 98 % on daily syncs.

panels.title: Ingested items
panels.description: Items of the extension's ingest batches per second, by platform and outcome (shelfy_ingest_items_total, P2-09; no data before it ships).
